review.summary: This PR refactors Sarvam STT/TTS to use config dataclasses for cleaner model-specific behavior, adding saaras:v3 and bulbul:v3-beta support. The refactor is generally well-structured, but there are inconsistencies between documentation and code (default v3 speaker), removed parameters (input_audio_codec) without explanation, and a likely backward-incompatible change to the default sample rate behavior. The "ignored parameter" warnings fire on user-set defaults, generating noise. There's also a removed call to a previously-public socket method that may affect downstream callers.

issues.description: Default v3 speaker mismatch between docs/PR description and code
issues.detail: PR description and module docstring state the default speaker for bulbul:v3-beta is 'aditya', but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. This contradiction will confuse users and break expectations set by documentation. Pick one and make them consistent across config, docstring, and PR notes.

issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT connect kwargs
issues.detail: The previous _connect() passed 'input_audio_codec' to the Sarvam SDK; the new version removes it entirely with no comment or explanation. If the SDK still expects/uses it (e.g., for non-wav input), users currently relying on input_audio_codec will see a behavior regression. Either restore it or document the removal as intentional.

issues.description: Warnings fire on Pydantic field defaults, creating noise
issues.detail: The 'ignored parameter' warnings trigger when params.pitch != 0.0, params.loudness != 1.0, params.temperature != 0.6. Since InputParams defaults are exactly these values, any user who instantiates InputParams() with v3 model and never touches these fields is fine — but any user explicitly setting them gets warned. The check should distinguish 'explicitly set' from 'default'; use model_fields_set or Pydantic's exclude_unset to only warn on user-supplied values.

issues.description: Default sample_rate behavior changed in backward-incompatible way
issues.detail: Previously sample_rate was passed to super().__init__ as None (parent handled default). Now if sample_rate=None, it's auto-set to config.default_sample_rate (22050 for v2, 24000 for v3). Existing users on bulbul:v2 relying on the previous default (possibly 16000 from STTService parent or upstream config) may experience an unexpected sample rate change. Verify the prior default matched 22050 or note the behavior shift.

issues.description: set_prompt silently no-ops with prompt=None on unsupported models
issues.detail: When a model doesn't support prompts and prompt=None is passed, set_prompt silently returns. This is intentional (the comment says so), but for set_prompt(None) on an unsupported model, callers may expect a no-op or a clear log. Consider logging a debug message instead of total silence to aid troubleshooting.

issues.description: Pace clamping logs a warning but pace=None bypasses validation
issues.detail: The clamp block only runs when pace is not None. params.pace has default 1.0, so this is fine in practice, but the warning message says 'Clamping' without including the new value. Include the clamped value in the log so operators can see what was actually sent to the API.
